title: LEQ and NEQ
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Given is a sequence of $N$ integers $A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_N$. Print the number, modulo $998244353$, of sequences of $N$ integers $X_1,X_2,\ldots,X_N$ satisfying all of the following conditions:

- $1 \leq X_i \leq A_i$
- $X_i \neq X_{i+1} (1 \leq i \leq N-1)$

## Constraints

- $2 \leq N \leq 5 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
```

## Output

Print the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定一个由 $N$ 个整数构成的序列 $A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_N$。请输出满足以下所有条件的 $N$ 个整数构成的序列 $X_1,X_2,\ldots,X_N$ 的数量，答案对 $998244353$ 取模。

- $1 \leq X_i \leq A_i$
- $X_i \neq X_{i+1} (1 \leq i \leq N-1)$

## 约束条件

- $2 \leq N \leq 5 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note:
The following six sequences satisfy all of the conditions.

- $1,2,1$
- $1,3,1$
- $1,3,2$
- $2,1,2$
- $2,3,1$
- $2,3,2$
